verdict.rationale: The evidence covers feature gates, experiments, SDKs, CI/CD CLI, and MCP integrations, but nothing describes a dedicated sandbox/staging environment or a way to test Statsig configurations without affecting production data. Feature Gate overrides and target apps are still production-facing scoping tools, not an isolated test environment. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment, test project separation from production data, documentation of a non-production testing mode.
